    - **3.1.3 Tense and then relax each muscle group, one at a time, from feet to head.**  
      <sub>also: Use progressive muscle relaxation (PMR) before bed · Progressive Muscle Relaxation · PMR</sub>

## Myths

- **Alcohol may make you drowsy, but it makes sleep worse later in the night.**  
  <sub>`myth-alcohol-helps-sleep` · “Myth: Alcohol helps you sleep better.” · 5 cited · for: adults</sub>
- **Sleeping in on weekends doesn't fully make up for short sleep during the week.**  
  <sub>`myth-weekend-catch-up` · “Myth: You can "catch up" on lost sleep during weekends.” · 3 cited</sub>
- **Regular exercise helps sleep, but hard workouts right before bed can keep you up.**  
  <sub>`myth-exercise-right-before-bed` · “Myth: Exercising right before bed improves sleep.” · 4 cited</sub>
- **Falling asleep to TV can make sleep lighter and more broken.**  
  <sub>`myth-tv-helps-you-sleep` · “Myth: Watching TV helps you fall asleep.” · 4 cited</sub>
- **Loud, frequent snoring can be a sign of sleep apnea and is worth checking.**

## Do One Thing: commitments by sleep thief

HCF's Do One Thing habits ([source](https://doonething.sleepliteracy.org/choose-your-one-thing/)), each linked to the concept it applies. *Italic* = mindset line; ⚠️ = numbers to check; duplicates (site errors) are listed but not linked.

### Irregular Schedules (and Social Jetlag)

- Tip: Aim to keep your bedtime and wake-up time within the same hour every day, even on weekends. → `keep-a-regular-sleep-schedule`, `dont-sleep-in-much-on-weekends` ⚠️ within the same hour
- Tip: If you’re up late, try a short nap the next day instead of sleeping in for hours, which can make the cycle worse. → `keep-naps-short-and-early`, `dont-sleep-in-much-on-weekends`
- Tip: Plan social activities earlier when you can — morning coffee catch-ups or evening walks can replace midnight hangouts. → `plan-social-time-earlier`
- Tip: Use consistent cues — morning sunlight, light exercise, and hydration — to help your body reset after a late night. → `get-morning-daylight`, `move-in-the-morning`

#### Weekend vs Weekday Gap

- *I will remind myself that consistency is freedom, not restriction.* → `dont-sleep-in-much-on-weekends`
- *I will treat Sunday nights as a gentle reset, preparing for the week with intention.* → `keep-a-regular-sleep-schedule`

#### Work & School Deadlines

- I will finish schoolwork by 9 pm so my brain has time to slow down before sleep. → `finish-work-earlier` ⚠️ 9 pm
- I will plan my hardest tasks for earlier in the day, leaving evenings calm. → `finish-work-earlier`
- I will give myself a 30-minute buffer between work and screens before bed. → `finish-work-earlier`, `screens-before-bed` ⚠️ 30-minute buffer
- *I will stop treating exhaustion as productivity and instead value sleep as part of my success.* → `get-enough-sleep-for-you`
- I will close my laptop before I feel depleted, not after. → `finish-work-earlier`

#### Social Commitments

- I will suggest earlier meet-ups so fun doesn’t mean fatigue. → `plan-social-time-earlier`
- I will cap social calls by 10 pm, choosing depth over late-night chatter. → `plan-social-time-earlier` ⚠️ 10 pm
- I will trade one late-night hangout each week for a morning coffee ritual with a friend. → `plan-social-time-earlier`
- *I will be honest with friends about needing rest, knowing true friends will support me.* → `plan-social-time-earlier`
- *I will let social joy add to my energy, not drain it.* → `plan-social-time-earlier`

#### Circadian Rhythm Cues

- I will step outside for sunlight within 30 minutes of waking. → `get-morning-daylight` ⚠️ within 30 minutes of waking
- I will stretch or move my body every morning to signal the day has begun. → `move-in-the-morning`
- I will use the same nightly ritual — dim lights, tea, quiet — to signal sleep. → `have-a-wind-down-routine`
- I will end each day with a simple phrase of gratitude to mark closure. → `gratitude-list`
- *I will trust that my body thrives on rhythm and will reward me with better sleep.* → `keep-a-regular-sleep-schedule`

### Technology and Screen Time

- Tip: Set a “tech curfew” at least one hour before bedtime. → `screens-before-bed` ⚠️ at least one hour
- Tip: Use blue-light filters or night-shift modes if screens are unavoidable in the evening. → `less-bright-light-in-the-evening`, `screens-before-bed`
- Tip: Keep your phone out of reach during the night to avoid disruptive notifications. → `keep-devices-out-of-the-bedroom`
- Tip: Replace screens with a relaxing bedtime routine — reading, journaling, stretching, or even light music. → `have-a-wind-down-routine`

#### Evening Phone/Tablet Use

- I will set a tech curfew one hour before bed. → `screens-before-bed` ⚠️ one hour before bed
- I will charge my phone outside the bedroom overnight. → `keep-devices-out-of-the-bedroom`
- I will replace scrolling with one page of reading or journaling. → `screens-before-bed`
- *I will greet mornings with intention, not with notifications.* → `keep-devices-out-of-the-bedroom`
- *I will see my bed as a place for rest, not a workstation.* → `bed-is-for-sleep`

#### TV & Streaming Habits

- I will stop watching shows by 9:30 pm, choosing rest over another episode. → `screens-before-bed` ⚠️ 9:30 pm
- I will shift my favorite shows earlier so my nights end quietly. → `screens-before-bed`
- I will swap one binge night for an early night of deep sleep each week. → `screens-before-bed`
- *I will treat the ‘next episode’ button as an intentional choice, not a reflex.* → `screens-before-bed`
- *I will remember that true cliffhangers resolve best after a good night’s rest.* → `screens-before-bed`

#### Gaming & Social Media Stimulation

- I will finish gaming or social feeds at least an hour before bed. → `screens-before-bed` ⚠️ an hour before bed
- I will set a timer so playtime ends while I still feel in control. → `screens-before-bed`
- I will move one gaming session into the afternoon instead of the evening. → `screens-before-bed`
- *I will remind myself that digital wins don’t matter if I lose tomorrow’s energy.* → `screens-before-bed`
- *I will choose calm over stimulation when the night deepens.* → `skip-exciting-things-before-bed`

#### Bedroom Environment & Devices

- I will keep my phone out of reach at night so sleep stays undisturbed. → `keep-devices-out-of-the-bedroom`
- I will use an alarm clock instead of relying on my phone. → `use-an-alarm-clock`
- I will make my bedroom a tech-free sanctuary. → `keep-devices-out-of-the-bedroom`
- *I will honor my bed as a temple of rest, not a glowing workspace.* → `bed-is-for-sleep`
- I will wake to sunlight or gentle sounds, not to pings and alerts. → `keep-devices-out-of-the-bedroom`, `get-morning-daylight`

### Stress, Anxiety, and Mental Load

- Tip: Build a calming wind-down routine with dim lights and quiet activities. → `have-a-wind-down-routine`
- Tip: Practice mindfulness, meditation, or deep breathing before bed — even 5 minutes helps. → `relaxation-techniques` ⚠️ 5 minutes
- Tip: Write down to-do lists or worries earlier in the evening to clear your mind. → `write-down-worries`
- Tip: If poor sleep persists for more than a few weeks, talk with a professional — you don’t have to navigate it alone. → `get-help-if-poor-sleep-persists` ⚠️ more than a few weeks

#### Get Exercise

- ~~I will write tomorrow’s to-do list before dinner.~~ (duplicate of `dot-work-school-1`)
- ~~I will stop working at least one hour before bed.~~ (duplicate of `dot-work-school-2`)
- ~~I will celebrate what I finish each day instead of focusing on what remains.~~ (duplicate of `dot-work-school-3`)
- ~~I will end my workday with a short ritual that signals ‘done.’~~ (duplicate of `dot-work-school-4`)
- ~~I will trust that rest is the most important work of all.~~ (duplicate of `dot-work-school-5`)

#### Work/School Responsibilities

- I will write tomorrow’s to-do list before dinner. → `write-down-worries` ⚠️ before dinner
- I will stop working at least one hour before bed. → `finish-work-earlier` ⚠️ one hour before bed
- *I will celebrate what I finish each day instead of focusing on what remains.* → `calm-your-mind-before-bed`
- I will end my workday with a short ritual that signals ‘done.’ → `finish-work-earlier`
- *I will trust that rest is the most important work of all.* → `get-enough-sleep-for-you`

#### Relationships & Family Concerns

- I will journal three good things about my relationships each night. → `gratitude-list` ⚠️ three good things
- I will save serious conversations for the day, not bedtime. → `avoid-heavy-talks-at-bedtime`
- ~~I will save serious conversations for the day, not bedtime.~~ (duplicate of `dot-relationships-2`)
- *I will rest knowing love is nurtured in patience, not in late-night arguments.* → `avoid-heavy-talks-at-bedtime`
- *I will hold my family in compassion as I drift to sleep.* → `calm-your-mind-before-bed`

#### Financial/Practical Worries

- I will set aside 15 minutes in the evening for practical planning. → `write-down-worries` ⚠️ 15 minutes
- I will separate financial worries from sleep by addressing them during daylight. → `write-down-worries`
- I will balance worries by writing down three daily wins. → `gratitude-list` ⚠️ three daily wins
- *I will remind myself that tomorrow always brings fresh perspective.* → `calm-your-mind-before-bed`
- *I will treat rest as the best investment in my future.* → `get-enough-sleep-for-you`

#### Mental Health Conditions

- I will practice 5 minutes of mindful breathing before bed. → `relaxation-techniques` ⚠️ 5 minutes
- I will seek help when I need it, knowing strength is asking. → `get-help-if-poor-sleep-persists`
- *I will give myself grace on rough nights.* → `be-kind-to-yourself-after-a-bad-night`
- *I will see poor sleep not as failure but as feedback.* → `be-kind-to-yourself-after-a-bad-night`
- *I will anchor myself in rituals that remind me I am safe.* → `have-a-wind-down-routine`

### Caffeine, Alcohol, Marijuana, and Poor Dietary Habits

- Tip: Cut off caffeine by early afternoon. → `caffeine-cutoff`
- Tip: Avoid alcohol close to bedtime; stop drinking at least 3 hours before sleep. → `no-alcohol-close-to-bedtime` ⚠️ at least 3 hours
- Tip: If using marijuana, keep doses moderate and track how it affects your rest. → `cannabis-and-sleep`
- Tip: Finish heavy meals 2–3 hours before bed; opt for light snacks if you’re hungry late. → `caffeine-and-big-meals-early`, `small-snack-before-bed` ⚠️ 2–3 hours
- Tip: Stay hydrated earlier in the day and taper fluids at night to minimize middle-of-the-night wake-ups. → `drink-more-earlier-in-the-day`

#### Caffeine Timing

- I will enjoy coffee only before 2 p.m. → `caffeine-cutoff` ⚠️ before 2 p.m.
- I will switch to calming teas in the evening. → `herbal-tea-before-bed`
- I will savor my morning coffee instead of chasing energy late. → `caffeine-cutoff`
- I will trade my afternoon coffee for a short walk outside. → `caffeine-cutoff`
- *I will let natural rhythms, not caffeine, guide my nights.* → `caffeine-cutoff`

#### Alcohol Timing & Quantity

- I will avoid drinking within three hours of bed. → `no-alcohol-close-to-bedtime` ⚠️ three hours
- I will enjoy drinks socially, not as sleep aids. → `no-alcohol-close-to-bedtime`
- I will replace nightcaps with water or calming tea. → `no-alcohol-close-to-bedtime`, `herbal-tea-before-bed`
- *I will see mornings without grogginess as my reward.* → `no-alcohol-close-to-bedtime`
- *I will remind myself that alcohol steals dreams as it steals REM.* → `no-alcohol-close-to-bedtime` ⚠️ claim: alcohol 'steals REM'

#### Marijuana Use

- I will pause cannabis at least one hour before bed. → `cannabis-and-sleep` ⚠️ one hour before bed
- I will track how it affects my sleep with curiosity. → `cannabis-and-sleep`, `keep-a-sleep-diary`
- I will explore alternatives like reading or music at night. → `cannabis-and-sleep`, `have-a-wind-down-routine`
- *I will choose balance over reliance.* → `cannabis-and-sleep`
- *I will honor my body’s need for natural cycles of dreaming.* → `cannabis-and-sleep`

#### Meal Timing & Size

- I will finish dinner two to three hours before bed. → `caffeine-and-big-meals-early` ⚠️ two to three hours
- I will choose lighter snacks at night instead of heavy meals. → `small-snack-before-bed`
- *I will eat with attention to fullness, not habit.* → `caffeine-and-big-meals-early`
- *I will let hunger guide me wisely, not late-night impulse.* → `small-snack-before-bed`
- *I will honor my body with timing that supports renewal.* → `caffeine-and-big-meals-early`

#### Hydration Timing

- I will drink most of my water earlier in the day. → `drink-more-earlier-in-the-day`
- I will taper fluids after 8 pm to protect deep sleep. → `drink-more-earlier-in-the-day` ⚠️ after 8 pm
- I will enjoy a small calming drink before bed, not a large one. → `drink-more-earlier-in-the-day`, `herbal-tea-before-bed`
- *I will see hydration as rhythm, not a last-minute scramble.* → `drink-more-earlier-in-the-day`
- *I will keep my nights for dreams, not for interruptions.* → `drink-more-earlier-in-the-day`

## Merged

- `naps-and-night-sleep` → `keep-naps-short-and-early` (“Naps harm nighttime sleep”)
- `dim-the-lights-after-dark` → `less-bright-light-in-the-evening` (“Dim the Lights at Night”)
